title: Certified Sieve Bounds with Finite-Sample Coverage for Causal Queries in Mixed-Variable ADMGs
banked_reason: The strongest honest result is forward-only exact-multinomial projection coverage and conditional certificate soundness; reverse exact-code lifting and terminating mixed-variable certification remain unproved, so the result is incremental below the field floor.
gap_reasons: From finite cell masses, response intervals, and set-valued boundary routes, the reverse direction does not derive a Lipschitz/measurable selection whose actual kappa-code probabilities equal the recorded masses: (7) is asserted, not constructed.

This is a certificate-program-specific uniform enclosure oracle, not a primitive or derived property of the stated rational grammar; give concrete integration conditions and an enclosure construction with the claimed uniform rate, or rescope computation to an explicitly algorithmic integrable grammar.

ass:semialgebraic-code permits Boolean combinations of weak inequalities, hence negated atoms and strict cells; the proof's claims that every constraint is weak, the feasible set is closed/compact, and empty boxes are excluded by closedness do not follow.

The stated target is Theta(p_0), but the executable I_out brackets only Theta_cert(p_0); make the two deliverables and their targets explicit and do not present the subclass certificate as the functional for the full-class target.

The neural result is only conditional on already possessing independently certified near-extremal witnesses; their existence, construction, and vanishing representation residual remain open, despite the neural-certification framing.
proof_attempt_summary: The run built a dyadic response-function outer-sieve argument, exact multinomial projection coverage, a binary-bow witness, and a proposed rational branch-and-bound certificate. The reverse coded-law lifting collapsed because the frozen assumptions do not construct the required Lipschitz measurable selections, while strict cells and an assumed integration oracle prevent the advertised terminating certificate theorem. Forward-only coverage and conditional certificate soundness remain valid incremental content, but not the field-tier mixed-variable sharpness or neural endpoint claim.
tldr: For a known acyclic ADMG with compact mixed variables and a fixed measurable finite observational code, an abstract district-coupled response sieve yields two-sided exact-coded-law lifting and exact finite-sample coverage of the full Lipschitz-class identified set induced by that code, not by the unbinned law. Computation is separated and totalized for rational support boxes, rational \(\alpha\), semialgebraic code cells, and the specified rational piecewise-polynomial or ReLU grammar: an exact real-algebraic layer first certifies infeasibility and returns the distinguished empty set, or certifies program nonemptiness and then a finite rational branch-and-bound tree checks both endpoints. Certified near-extremal neural witnesses form an inner interval only on the nonempty branch, while Autobounds and the UA-DCM Parents' Labor Supply analysis remain implementation and decision consumers rather than sources of additional headline claims.
gap: Definition 2.3 and Theorem 2.4 of Zhang, Tian, and Bareinboim establish finite exact canonicalization. Tan, Blanchet, and Syrgkanis define a finite-sample estimator and establish mixed-variable graphwise Wasserstein approximation together with almost-sure asymptotic consistency and bracketing. Neither comparator supplies two-sided preservation of a fixed finite coded observational law with uniform query error and exact finite-sample coverage of the entire coded-law identified set, and no inclusion between their model classes and \(M_G\) is claimed. Existing global-optimization work does not state the rational likelihood-region, coded-law, and integral encoding needed for independent certificates.
fill: The project proves the full-class two-sided lifting and exact whole-set coverage for the fixed coded law, then proves finite termination and soundness only for rational boxes, rational \(\alpha\), semialgebraic code cells, rational piecewise-polynomial or ReLU mechanisms and queries, and exact or certified outer integral encodings. Near-extremal neural witnesses are checked against explicit neural extrema, and their formal residual is separated from mesh, integral-enclosure, and optimization errors. Autobounds supplies an implementation setting; the UA-DCM Parents' Labor Supply sign check is recorded only as a downstream consequence of outer-set containment.
